comments.value: THANK YOU! It's such a struggle trying to communicate through VRchat, especially if there are misunderstandings. It doesn't help trying to message people through Discord either because sometimes people just don't check their DMs when they're on VR (I'm guilty of this). It'd save a lot of hassle.

This would be incredibly convenient. Sometimes you dont want to load a completely different world or exit vr just to send a quick message so that someone could know that "hey, we're on this world now" or just a private message to that one person when youre with a group of people.  I would love to see this implemented in any way
Making a messaging system like the community asked for OVER 5 YEARS, would be the easiest way. But still, a pretty relevant suggestion. I'm all in.

details:
I want to be able to send a "Reply" without having to receive an invite first.

I want to be able to reply to a reply.

I've seen some suggestions of an in-game messaging system, and I really think this is the way to do it.

Add a new button next to invite and request invite that says message. then allow people to use the system already in place for replies to send a message.

Allow people to reply to the message. allow people to reply to a reply.
title: Messages through reply system
